I completed my BSc in Biology in 2024 at the Faculty of Sciences, University of Lisbon. I am currently finishing my Master's degree, working alongside my supervisors, Tiago Guerreiro and Diogo Branco. My thesis focuses on how different contextual factors influence gait in People with Parkinson's.

I am deeply motivated to continue researching how contextual data can uncover the unique challenges these patients face, paving the way for targeted improvement strategies and exploring new challenges related to Parkinson's, other diseases, and accessibility.

In my free time, I stay active by playing volleyball and enjoy unwinding by watching movies and series, or playing video and board games.
